fisher_stability: pairwise Spearman rank correlation plus Top-K Jaccard at K from {10,0.05D,0.10D,0.20D}
diversity: mean pairwise normalized Hamming among current population at generations 0,1,3,6
sparse_control: matched base population; same three frozen MSF subset sizes; Fisher score vector permuted across feature identities with RNG seed+9001 before top-k seeding; standard NSGA-II thereafter
